Bonding Wires

From heavy wires to ribbons, Heraeus Electronics offers a complete range of high-performance bonding wires for diverse applications. We ensure precise specifications and streamlined processes for efficient production. Trust us for reliable bonding wire solutions. All wires meet the SGS/RoHS requirements and are thus licensed and in compliance with legal requirements including REACH and RoHS.

Fine Bonding Wire

At Heraeus Electronics, we offer a complete range of fine bonding wires covering different application needs and requirements. Our fine bonding wires range from precious metal Gold and Silver wire types to lower-cost Copper and Aluminium alternatives. 

Discover various types that fits right for your application.

Fine Bonding Ribbons 

Discover Heraeus Fine Bonding Ribbons – precision-engineered for high-reliability applications with excellent heat dissipation, uniform composition, and customizable designs for industries like telecom, automotive, and optoelectronics.

Fine Bonding Ribbons

Discover how Fine Ribbons (thickness ≤ 75µm) deliver precise power transmission and low inductivity, ranging from Gold and Silver to AlSi.

Thick Bonding Ribbons 

Reliable, high-performance ribbons for demanding applications. Designed for enhanced power transmission and heat dissipation. No particles and cut edges due to special manufacturing process using rolling technology. Trust Heraeus Electronics for durable and efficient thick ribbon solutions.
